s1.dir: Count 'Three... two... one...' slowly and clearly with a pause between each number, then burst out the last part fast and super excited, rising pitch.

s2.text: Move around and find a spot!
s2.dir: Medium pace, friendly and inviting, playful melody, rising intonation at the end.

s3.dir: A fast rhythmic chant, each 'dig' bouncier and louder than the last, ending with a giggle.

s4.dir: Slower and hushed, curious like sharing a secret, pitch rising at the end.

s5.dir: A quick gasp of surprise on 'Oh no!', then playful and fast, ending with a little laugh.

s6.dir: Urgent and quick, encouraging, like cheering someone on.

s7.dir: A big bouncy stretched 'Boing!', then bright and fast and happy.

s8.dir: Sweet and relieved, medium pace, high warm pitch, smiling.

s9.dir: Fast surprised 'Splash!', then giggly and amused.

s10.dir: Quick playful urgency, like a fun little emergency.

s11.dir: Slow and dramatic on 'Treasure!', then fast and sparkly excited.

s12.dir: Shout 'Dinosaur!' excitedly, then do a playful deep growly 'Roar!' like a friendly monster.

s13.dir: Surprised 'Whoa!', then slow and sleepy-sounding on 'a sleepy mole', with a yawn-like tone.

s14.dir: A sharp punchy 'Bonk!', then amazed and slower, stretching 'giant'.

s15.dir: Slow, wondering and curious, pitch rising at the end like a fun question.

s16.dir: Quick, encouraging cheer, like a coach.

s17.dir: Determined and building energy, then a fast playful 'Vroom!' like a car engine.

s18.dir: Triumphant, fast and celebratory, like announcing a winner.

s19.dir: Calm, clear and kind but a little serious, slower pace, lower pitch.

p1.dir: Fast delighted praise, high pitch, big smile.

p2.dir: Fast delighted praise, stretch 'Super', high pitch.

p3.dir: Amazed and delighted, 'Wow' stretched, then fast.

p4.dir: Warm proud praise, medium pace, rising at the end.

p5.dir: Quick and fun, like inviting a high five.
